variants.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit. Image 1 is the APPROVED EDIT TARGET: the D1 “清透天蓝 / 伙伴大合照” loading-screen artwork for the game “泡泡小队”. Prepare production background artwork, keeping the approved design. Preserve the exact five recognizable plush companions, their faces, poses, original blue/orange/green/pink/white colors, fur, felt pots with stitched motifs, green leaves, bright sky-blue background, white fluffy clouds, pastel rainbow arch and translucent bubbles. Preserve the exact Chinese game title “泡泡小队” at the top with white plush letters and blue backing, including the tiny pink heart. Keep clean high-key neutral light, clear blue and genuinely white fur/clouds, fine visible fluffy fibers. Do not invent a new design or change the character identities.

Remove ALL lower loading-interface elements from the image: remove “加载中…36%”, remove the entire progress-bar outline and fill, remove “健康游戏忠告” and every line of footer text. Inpaint these areas with continuous clean white / very pale ice-blue clouds matching the approved art. The ONLY text remaining anywhere must be the game title “泡泡小队”. NO loading bar, NO footer words, NO labels, NO interface. Actual progress and advisory will be HTML layered afterward. No dark shadow, no vintage/sepia/faded color grading, no extra characters, no crop of faces. Opaque full-bleed artwork, no phone frame.
LONG PHONE VERSION: preserve the original 9:19.5 portrait aspect ratio, ideally 1080x2340. Keep the original title and five-character group arrangement as close as possible to the reference. All characters and pots should finish by about 78% of image height; the bottom 21% must be a calm clean pale-white cloud surface for later HTML. Preserve original bright art and composition above the removed lower interface.

refinement.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit. Image 1 is the existing approved bright-blue plush “泡泡小队” loading background, SHORT SCREEN version. Make ONE TARGETED LAYOUT CORRECTION ONLY. The artwork currently fills too much vertical space, so real loading UI would cover the front pots. Keep the exact bright colors, five plush characters, expressions, title lettering, thin fur, clouds, rainbow and bubbles. Preserve the 9:16 portrait aspect ratio, ideally 1080x1920. Do NOT add any new text or loading UI.

REQUIRED COORDINATES (fractions of full canvas height): the game title must fit entirely between 8% and 22%; the five-character group INCLUDING the bottom edges of ALL felt pots and the green decorative mound must fit entirely between 25% and 72%. Scale the whole five-character group UNIFORMLY to approximately 80% of its current size and move it upward, allowing more margin on both sides. Preserve their same relative arrangement: large blue bear center-back, orange capybara left, green frog right, pink rabbit and white kitten foreground. Don't squeeze or stretch characters. Make the rainbow arch smaller to frame the resized group. The bottom 27% (from y=73% to 100%) must contain ONLY clean white / extremely pale ice-blue fluffy clouds as a calm blank region, with absolutely NO character faces, pots, leaves, flowers, lettering, bars, icons or bubbles. The lowest visible pot must end before y=73%; this is critical. No yellow cast. Full-bleed opaque image, crisp modern bright-blue toy artwork and visible fur, not a poster inside a frame.
